messages:
Elaine: quick follow-up from today's console arch sync — sketched a two-phase approach for widget virtualization + RBAC checks.
Kartik: short version? are we avoiding an authz call on every tile render
Elaine: phase-1: server-side authorize-at-query with a short cache (60s) keyed to token+tenant+route; phase-2: push auth predicates into query planner for filter pushdown and to enable shard/KV cache reuse.
Sam: that helps perf, but cache TTL+tenant switching could surface wrong results if not keyed properly
Elaine: agreed, that's why cache key includes token hash + tenant id + route + flags. TTL = 60s initially while we measure hit/miss.
Oliver: streaming widgets complicate this — role changes mid-stream are a thing
Monica: options: per-chunk auth checks (expensive) or keep stream-scoped creds and terminate the stream on auth-change. i'm leaning to terminate + clear reason metric.
Kartik: UX vs cost. terminating stream on change is simpler but might surprise users. per-chunk checks mean throughput hit and complicated cancellation semantics.
Elaine: noted. another win: if we inject predicates earlier we avoid post-filtering which currently prevents KV-cache reuse in runtime and inflates tokens served.
Sam: can we prototype and A/B select tenants? want canary traffic first
Elaine: rollout plan: opt-in flag on dashboard route (?auth_pushdown=1). default off. canary tenants for 1 week. track 95p latency, tokens/op, auth_cache.hitrate, postfilter.count, and error rate.
Oliver: need config snippet so deploy bot can hook it
Elaine: ```yaml
# console-config snippet
routes:
  /dash/widgets:
    auth_pushdown: opt-in
    auth_cache_ttl_seconds: 60
    stream_behavior: stop-on-auth-change
```
Monica: add metric names in rollout doc: console.auth_pushdown.enabled, console.auth_cache.hitrate, console.query.postfilter.count
Kartik: add automatic rollback rule: if post-filter count increases >10% or p95 latency +20% revert.
Sam: RBAC team needs to sign off on predicate grammar — we plan to push expressions into SQL planner, they must audit allowed operators.
Elaine: @Kartik please coordinate with auth team on predicate contract.
Kartik: will do. timeline: prototype this week; canary deploy next Tue; observe 1 week.
deploy-bot: deploy request: console-config v2026.04.12-alpha -> canary cluster queued :rocket:
Elaine: action items: 1) Kartik: spec predicate contract + share w/ RBAC (due Thu). 2) Oliver: add stream-stop-reason metric (due Fri). 3) Sam: add rollback circuit to rollout playbook (due Mon). 4) Monica: update dashboards & alerts.
Monica: i'll create dashboards and set preliminary alert thresholds
Kartik: small question: multi-tenant cache isolation — how to avoid cross-tenant evictions?
Elaine: cache key = sha256(user-token || tenant-id || route || featureflags). isolates tenants and tokens.
Sam: also tag auth-cache-miss so we can correlate miss spikes to post-filter operations.
Elaine: i'll draft a short RFC follow-up in the repo with the plan, metrics & config, and ping here for any blockers :thumbsup:
